title: REPORT on the implementation of the common security and defence policy – annual report 2024
part_text: 27. Welcomes the joint efforts undertaken thus far to strengthen the EU’s defence readiness through measures reinforcing and supporting the adaptation of the EDTIB, notably through the EDIRPA and ASAP regulations, and calls for their swift implementation; regrets that the financial envelope of EDIRPA remains limited and points out that the role of ASAP in relation to the ambition of supplying Ukraine with one million pieces of ammunition was restrained by the insufficient budget for the instrument and the lack of sufficient administrative preparation for participation in competitions, especially by SMEs and midcaps, not by the Council’s objection to its regulatory elements, which Member States have rightly considered to be an excessively far-reaching interference in their exclusive competences; is critical of any EU defence programmes in which there are no national allocations;
